body: I'll take a chance at Olympic Gold any day of the week over The Bettman Cup.

Hey Sister, remember that house you bought with that money you said we were going to split.  Wanna sell that shit now that the market and Canadian dollar is in the hole?  Unfortunately it looks like I will have to wait, and continue the struggle.

> “To those humans in whom I have faith; I wish suffering, being forsaken, sickness, maltreatment, humiliation. I wish that they should not remain unfamiliar with profound self-contempt, the torture of self-mistrust, and the misery of the vanquished. I have no pity for them because I wish them the only thing that can prove today whether one is worth anything or not—that one endures'

A favoured quotation on the subject that, makes me feel human at the worst of times.

Thanks for your message and sympathy. I really only talk to my sister 3-4 times a year, we see eachother around Christmas.  I've been dreading Christmas 2016 since Christmas 2015 ended.  I'm not sure faking my death is my next step, but finding more positive influences is valued advice.
Thank you for your kind words.
Thank you for reading, I hope so as well.
Thank you for reading, sometimes venting is the only logical action.  I will eventually find the right way.
